name: BrandPilot AI Inc
summary: BrandPilot AI Inc., a digital advertising technology company specializing in AI-driven performance marketing in Canada. The company offers Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platforms leveraging machine learning and automation; and AdAi that enables brands to reduce spending on branded search which integrates with Performance Max, Dynamic Search Ads, Shopping Ads, SA360, and Smart Bidding campaigns. It also offers Spectrum IQ, an AI-powered influencer marketing platform that helps brands scale engagement by activating micro-influencers across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Twitch and connects directly with Shopify and WooCommerce; and Social Runway, a social media management tool designed for agencies and marketers, enabling bulk content creation, scheduling, approvals, and inbox. The company was formerly known as Universal PropTech Inc. and changed its name to BrandPilot AI Inc. in June 2024. The company is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
